## Maintenance and Care for Rubbermaid Brilliance Food Storage Containers

Proper maintenance ensures your **Rubbermaid Brilliance food storage containers** retain their crystal-clear appearance and optimal performance for years. The advanced Tritan plastic construction simplifies cleaning while maintaining food safety standards that exceed FDA requirements for food contact materials.
### Daily Cleaning and Care Routine
**Hand Washing Method:**
• Use warm water and mild dish soap for regular cleaning
• Avoid abrasive cleaners that could scratch surfaces
• Rinse thoroughly to prevent soap residue buildup
**Dishwasher Guidelines:**
• Place containers on top rack only
• Use normal cycle settings with standard detergent
• Allow complete air drying before stacking
### Stain and Odor Prevention Strategies

While Brilliance containers resist most stains naturally, certain foods like tomato-based sauces or turmeric can cause discoloration. Soaking containers in a baking soda solution (2 tablespoons per cup of water) for 30 minutes effectively removes stubborn stains and odors.

## FAQ: Frequently Asked Questions About Rubbermaid Brilliance Food Storage Containers
**Q: Are Rubbermaid Brilliance food storage containers microwave safe?**

Yes, all Rubbermaid Brilliance containers are microwave-safe when used without lids. The Tritan plastic construction withstands temperatures up to 250°F, making them perfect for reheating leftovers and meal prep portions.
**Q: How do Brilliance containers prevent cloudiness over time?**

The proprietary Tritan plastic formula resists the micro-scratching that causes traditional plastic to become cloudy. This advanced material maintains 95% transparency even after years of regular use and dishwasher cycles.
**Q: Can I freeze food in Rubbermaid Brilliance containers?**
Absolutely! These containers are freezer-safe down to -10°F. Leave about 1 inch of headspace for liquid expansion, and always cool food completely before freezing to prevent thermal shock.
**Q: What makes the seal so effective compared to other containers?**

The four-lock sealing system creates multiple contact points around the lid perimeter, forming an airtight barrier that prevents moisture loss and contamination. This technology extends food freshness significantly compared to single-seal designs.
**Q: Are replacement lids available if mine gets damaged?**

Yes, Rubbermaid offers replacement lids for most Brilliance container sizes through their customer service and major retailers. This feature extends the product lifespan and protects your initial investment.
